title: The Prismatic Companion
summary: A companion for the crystal-aligned past the courses that splits one beam of qi into a whole spectrum of cutting light.

title: Treatise on the Standing Lattice
summary: A treatise on setting a lattice of crystal qi through the surrounding field to cage and cut whatever moves inside it.

title: Manual of the Azure Geode
summary: A manual of the blue-hearted geode of qi that holds closed against a siege of blows and opens in a bloom of crystal.

title: Canon of the Mirrored Field
summary: A canon of a field of silvered crystal that returns blows and flashes and heals the allies standing inside it.

title: The Gale-Cut Shard Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of shards flung on a hard wind so the crystal edges cut as they cross the field.

title: Treatise of the Singing Crystal
summary: A treatise on striking crystal qi until it rings and letting the ringing shatter weapons and clear the mind.
